Container.Name: tv-mt5-signal-bridge
Container.Overview: Receives TradingView webhook alerts and pushes them over ZeroMQ to the mt5-windows container's Expert Advisor. Part of tv-mt5-bridge -- a self-hosted TradingView-to-MT5 bridge. Requires a shared webhook secret and the mt5-windows container running alongside it.
Container.Requires: Install mt5-windows too. Set ZMQ_HOST below to your Unraid server's LAN IP (mt5-windows publishes the EA's ZeroMQ port there).

Config.Name: ZMQ_HOST
Config.Description: Your Unraid server's LAN IP (e.g. 192.168.1.10). Container names don't resolve on Unraid's default bridge network.

Config.Name: ZMQ_PORT
Config.Description: ZeroMQ PULL port the EA listens on

Config.Name: WEBHOOK_SECRET
Config.Description: Long random string. Must match the secret= field in your TradingView alerts. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: REQUIRE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
Config.Description: Leave true for anything reachable from the internet. Only set false for local-only testing.
